title: Upload links: refuse at issue a field whose readonlyWhen holds now (carries the issue-time readonlyWhen half of #32734)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWRcTEB3toGxnWvuvX

Carries the issue-time `readonlyWhen` half of #32734's first expected item; #32734 keeps the record-lock and static `readonly` refusal at issue, the consume-side refusal and the page text.

Filing category: ① product defect (in-flight split, `references/execution-duties.md` in-scope sub-issue; priority inherited).

Blocked-by: #32734

## Business reason

An agent asked to attach an invoice to an approved expense claim (a field read-only by `readonlyWhen`) still hands out an upload link. After #32734 the page refuses with the reason and keeps no file, but the person only learns it after picking and sending the file.

## What is missing

- `create_upload_link` cannot judge `readonlyWhen` at issue without writing: the engine's update preview (`engine.validate`, `ValidateDataResponse`) documents that it does not run `readonlyWhen`, and `getRecordFieldAccess` excludes conditional read-only and the approval lock. No write-free `readonlyWhen` judgement is exported.
- Measured by the #32734 card thread at d728d73e6d; re-check: `grep -n "readonlyWhen" packages/objectql/src/engine.ts packages/spec/src/**/validate*.ts`.

## Expected

- One write-free judgement of "is this field writable on this record now" that runs `readonlyWhen` (the engine's own, ⛔ no second CEL evaluation in `service-storage` or `packages/mcp`), and `create_upload_link` refuses with the same reason `update_record` gives.
- If the fix changes the update preview's documented limit, that is the engine contract's text: the claimer reads it first and states whether it widens a published surface (`Clause-②`).

Reader who acts: the `domain:server` engine face (`packages/objectql` validate preview), then `packages/mcp` `create_upload_link`.
Dedupe: parent #32734; `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue validate preview readonlyWhen` → 37 hits, the only open ones this card and a seat post (#18549); none on this.
